name: Tuition Fees And Examination Fees To Vjnt Students
benefit: All types of compulsory fees such as Tuition fees, and Exams. Fees & other fees are reimbursed to the concerned college/institution.
_eligibility_text:
1. He should belong to the Vimukta Jatis & Nomadic Tribes(VJNT) category.
1. Reimbursement will be sanctioned to the students, whose parents' income is between ₹ 1,00,000 to ₹ 4,50,000.
